Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Βαρλαάμ», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 19 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Varlaam»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Βαρλαάμ»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2903/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: an old man brought before the eparch of Antioch and burnt in the right hand, which is what the see in the folder's name records. The page's heading gives «(; - 304)» and the narrative «(304 μ.Χ.)», so a death interval is proposed where the folder had none. The apolytikion names him and gives both ἦχος and model and is taken; the page's «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», «Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε», is the common of a martyr and carries a tone but no model, and is not drafted. The page adds a detail no row can hold — «Η Σύναξή του τελείται στη μονή του που βρίσκεται κοντά στο Πανάρετο» — and it goes in the life. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Varlaam, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Varlaam», glas 4. The text is the common of a hieromartyr and addresses him as «Sfinţite Mucenice», a rank neither the calendar's line nor the life gives him; it is printed under his name and is copied whole, as it stands

english.text: Sharer in the ways of the Apostles and successor to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, the ascent to the vision of things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in the faith unto blood, hieromartyr Barlaam, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Νεανικὴν ἐνδεδυμένος ἀνδρείαν μαρτυρικήν, ἐν πολιᾷ καρτερίαν, σὺ ἐνεδείξω ἔνδοξε, δοξάσας τὸν Χριστόν. Τούτῳ δὲ προσήγαγες δεξιὰν κεκαυμένην, ὡς θυσίαν ἄμωμον τὴν ἁγίαν ψυχήν σου. μεγαλομάρτυς, πρέσβευε ἀεί, πᾶσιν δοθῆναι, Βαρλαάμ, συγχώρησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Βαρλαάμ». It names him and no other saint, and calls him μεγαλομάρτυς; the rank is the hymn's and no type is added from it. The lower-case «μεγαλομάρτυς» after a full stop is the page's own.

english.text: Clothed in the martyr's courage of a young man, you showed endurance in grey hairs, glorious one, and glorified Christ; to him you brought your burnt right hand, and your holy soul as an unblemished sacrifice. Great martyr Barlaam, intercede always that forgiveness be given to all.

death.note: saint.gr heads the page «Αγιος Βαρλααμ (; - 304)» and the narrative repeats the year for the hearing: «όταν τον έφεραν μπροστά στον έπαρχο Αντιοχείας (304 μ.Χ.)». The page gives no year of birth, only «τα βαθιά γεράματα του».
